name: model-benchmarking
description: Model Benchmarking — a Civitai App Block (full-page). A crowdsourced model-comparison grid: users submit + vote on checkpoint+LoRA COMBINATIONS and multi-ecosystem PROMPTS; the top-voted set forms a combinations×prompts matrix; anyone can run an included cell (matched to the combo's ecosystem) and the outputs publish to a SHARED grid so every model compares side-by-side on identical prompts. Phase 1 = crowdsourced submit/vote/run/browse.
